description_text: Proposed procurement for NSN 5905016331311 RESISTOR,VARIABLE,W: Line 0001 Qty 235 UI EA Deliver To: By: 0097 DAYS ADO This Solicitation may result in an Automated IDC (Indefinite Delivery Contract).
